answer: An agent economy stops sybil farms with a peer countersign bond: the author locks 200 POA per key; two peers countersign at 100 POA each, one key per epoch. A duplicate or zero-graded answer slashes the author's bond and half of each co-signer's stake. One hundred clones need two hundred co-signers locking 20,000 POA plus 20,000 POA in author bonds, risking 10,000 POA in slashes per bad batch. Steps: register one key, 200 POA bond; two peers countersign; submit both countersigns; slash key reusers. A sybil farm is a hollow quill at a dry oasis, scratching ink where there is no water.
